name: editStationInformation
description:
Updates station information including name, transport cost, and route assignment in the system.
User must provide ONE identification field and at least ONE update field. When updating the route, user can use either newRouteCode or newRouteName.

basic.name: editStationInformation
basic.description:
Updates station information including name, transport cost, and route assignment in the system.
User must provide ONE identification field and at least ONE update field. When updating the route, user can use either newRouteCode or newRouteName.

signature.name: editStationInformation

args.name: stationCode
args.description: The unique code identifier for the station to update (e.g., "000004")

args.name: stationName
args.description: The current name of the station to update (e.g., "Kottawa")

args.name: transportCost
args.description: The current transport cost to identify the station (e.g., "150.00")

args.name: routeName
args.description: The current route name to identify stations on that route (e.g., "Central Expressway")

args.name: newStationName
args.description: The new name for the station (e.g., "Kottawa-updated")

args.name: newRouteCode
args.description: The new route code to assign (e.g., "000004")

args.name: newRouteName
args.description: The new route name to assign (e.g., "Outer Circular Highway")
